desc: Transition task to INTEGRATION_FAILED when candidate artifact guard rejects before ref update, so the reviewer loop does not retry indefinitely against unchanged state.
done_when: When performCASMerge returns a pre-update hook error, MergeWorktree wraps it in IntegrationFailedError after marking the task INTEGRATION_FAILED (matching the post-merge backstop and merge-conflict error paths). The claiming.go retry loop observes IntegrationFailedError and continues without retrying. Tests verify: (1) task status transitions to INTEGRATION_FAILED, (2) error type is *IntegrationFailedError, (3) diagnostic includes candidate artifact ref details.
scope: internal/ops/wt_merge.go (MergeWorktree error handling for performCASMerge failures, lines ~540-543), internal/ops/wt_merge_test.go (update existing guard rejection tests to assert IntegrationFailedError wrapping and INTEGRATION_FAILED status transition)
